actions.sql: SELECT D.DOCID AS DOC_ID, D.DTLID AS DTL_ID, G.PRICE AS PRICE FROM V_COST_PINGGU_MATERIAL D JOIN T_COST_GOODS G ON G.GOODSID = D.GOODSID WHERE G.USEFLAG NOT IN ('产成品', '半成品') AND DECODE(D.PRICE, G.PRICE, 0, 1) = 1 ORDER BY D.DOCID, D.DTLID

SELECT D.DOCID AS DOC_ID, D.DTLID AS DTL_ID, G.PRICE AS PRICE FROM V_COST_PINGGU_PACKAGE D JOIN T_COST_GOODS G ON G.GOODSID = D.GOODSID WHERE G.USEFLAG NOT IN ('产成品', '半成品') AND DECODE(D.PRICE, G.PRICE, 0, 1) = 1 ORDER BY D.DOCID, D.DTLID
